title: Lumières, fleuve (Villa St Louis Ndar #12)
medium: Sand, Indian Ink and arabic gum on paper

said.q: This drawing was produced during an artistic residency at the Villa Ndar in Saint-Louis / Insitut de France in Senegal, in partnership with the DDESSIN PARIS salon. This art work was made on the banks of the Senegal River.
